messages.author: 88ac498246a7fdff
messages.subject: Problem in installing Rstan 2.0.0
parts:
Hi, 

I tried to install RStan 2.0 with

library(devtools)
install_url('https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/releases/download/v2.0.0/rstan_2.0.0.tar.gz')

After it downloaded rstan_2.0.0.tar.gz, an error message appeared with as
"Error: Does not appear to be an R package (no DESCRIPTION)"

I am working on R3.0.2 using RStudio. And "Hello World" is successful. 

It would be appreciated if you could point out what's wrong in my installation process. 

Regards
Fred

messages.author: 8c4f70ab584cd6d9
messages.subject: Re: Problem in installing Rstan 2.0.0
parts:
I had the old version of rstan installed with 32bit R 3.0.1. I uninstalled rstan, installed devtools, but could not connect to host. I using a proxy server, but typically the setInternet2(TRUE) command fixes the issue (I believe that's how I was able to install the older version of rstan).

> library(devtools)
Warning message:
package ‘devtools’ was built under R version 3.0.2
> setInternet2(TRUE)
> install_url('https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/releases/download/v2.0.0/rstan_2.0.0.tar.gz')
Downloading rstan_2.0.0.tar.gz from https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/releases/download/v2.0.0/rstan_2.0.0.tar.gz
Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : couldn't connect to host
